units: points, origin at the top left of the page, y downwards

lines.text: Case 01: deleted text (w:del) starts the second cell and the next row
Case 02: text moved away (w:moveFrom) starts the second cell and the next row; it moved to the
end of this label: Moved words Moved words
Case 03: inserted text (w:ins) starts the second cell and the next row (to compare)
Case 04: a paragraph of 30 lines crosses the page; deleted, moved-away and hidden words are in its
11th line; they moved to the end of this label: Moved words
